title: EFC Competitor-Models Test-Map
purpose: Not a catalogue of theories — a test-map of which rival frameworks EFC must differentiate against, and by what operational test. Each entry ties a model to a pipeline-level discriminator, not a narrative description. Use as the canonical WP3 competitor-landscape source.
author: Morten Magnusson

schema.name: Canonical model name
schema.key_papers: List of arXiv / DOI anchors (foundational or most-cited)
schema.efc_relation: rival (same domain, same target) | sibling (same ontology, different formulation) | orthogonal (different domain)
schema.overlap_with_efc: Observables both attempt to explain (RAR, lensing, growth, inflation, H0, ...)
schema.differentiating_test: The single test that separates this model from EFC if run today
schema.test_domain: List of physical regimes where the test is meaningful (galaxy | cluster | cosmology)
schema.prediction_type: pre-registered (frozen before data) | post-hoc (fitted after data) | qualitative (no numerical prediction)
schema.last_updated: ISO date of last literature check

guiding_principle: If 'differentiating_test' is weak, the model is irrelevant to EFC. A model without a sharp discriminator does not belong here.

items.name: MOND / QUMOND / AQUAL
items.core_claim: Modification of Newtonian dynamics at low acceleration scale a0 reproduces galaxy rotation curves and RAR without dark matter.
items.differentiating_test: Cluster lensing profiles and cosmological growth consistency.

items.name: TeVeS
items.core_claim: Relativistic extension of MOND introducing scalar, vector, and tensor fields.
items.differentiating_test: Simultaneous fit of lensing and CMB without additional dark sector components.

items.name: MOG / STVG
items.core_claim: Scalar-tensor-vector gravity modifies gravitational coupling and introduces vector field to mimic dark matter effects.
items.differentiating_test: Parameter stability across galaxy and cluster scales.

items.name: f(R) gravity
items.core_claim: Generalizes Einstein-Hilbert action with nonlinear function of Ricci scalar.
items.differentiating_test: Scale-dependent growth rate mu(k,z) vs LCDM and EFC predictions.

items.name: Emergent Gravity (Verlinde)
items.core_claim: Gravity emerges from entropic and holographic information considerations.
items.differentiating_test: Quantitative prediction of cluster lensing without free functions.

items.name: Entropic Gravity (Jacobson/Padmanabhan)
items.core_claim: Einstein equations derived from thermodynamic principles.
items.differentiating_test: Operational definition of entropy field vs EFC S-field.

items.name: Many-Body Gravity (Ganesh)
items.core_claim: Gravitational dynamics emerge from collective many-body interactions reproducing RAR, lensing, and inflation without dark matter.
items.differentiating_test: Out-of-sample galaxy performance and cluster kappa-profile vs EFC frozen predictions.

items.name: Early Dark Energy (EDE)
items.core_claim: Transient early-time dark energy component resolves H0 tension.
items.differentiating_test: CMB + BAO joint fit and growth suppression signatures.

items.name: Timescape Cosmology
items.core_claim: Apparent cosmic acceleration arises from inhomogeneous time flow between voids and walls.
items.differentiating_test: Redshift-distance relation vs standard candles across environments.

items.name: UTOR (Unified Theory of Reality)
items.core_claim: Not standardized in the mainstream literature; placeholder pending a canonical source.
items.differentiating_test: Requires canonical reference before a test can be defined.

next_steps: Map each entry to a concrete pipeline test (script + dataset + metric).
Build model -> dataset -> metric table for WP3 operationalization.
Run 2-3 rivals (start: MOND, Many-Body Gravity, Verlinde) head-to-head on SPARC 175 / Bullet Cluster with the frozen EFC Kill-Test v6 seed.
